description.en: Composable dithered charts and components for shadcn/ui on a tiny canvas engine.
description.zh: 基于轻量 Canvas 引擎的复古抖动风格图表与组件库，兼容 shadcn/ui 与 Recharts 式声明 API。

content.en: Dither Kit is a collection of composable, dithered charts and interactive UI components designed for shadcn/ui projects. Built on a tiny Canvas engine without Recharts, it renders area, bar, line, pie, and radar charts using ordered-dither fills that hold up across light and dark modes. It features entrance animations, gliding scrub tooltips, selection states, sparkles, and color bloom effects, with a children-as-config API and companion components like generative pixel avatars and dithered buttons.
content.zh: Dither Kit 是一套专为 shadcn/ui 生态打造的复古抖动风格图表与交互组件库。底层基于极简 Canvas 渲染引擎，摆脱了对 Recharts 的依赖，提供面积图、柱状图、折线图、饼图与雷达图等可视化图表。图表支持亮暗色有序抖动（Ordered Dither）填充、入场动效、平滑悬浮浮窗、光晕（Bloom）与微光闪烁效果，采用直观的子组件声明式配置 API，并附带生成式像素头像与抖动渐变按钮等衍生组件。
